title: psoralea swartbergensis
intro: Psoralea swartbergensis, commonly known as the Swartberg Psoralea, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family (Fabaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Psoralea swartbergensis include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit cytotoxic effects against certain cancer cell lines. The bioactive constituents of Psoralea swartbergensis include coumarins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
